# PR #1937: Patch: double the cosmetics: six new of each pickable kind, the first earnable chases and Mythics

Closes #1833

## Summary

This change doubles the cosmetics registry from 36 entries to 72. The 36 new ones are cosmetics an account earns, and they include the first Legendary and Mythic cosmetics that can actually drop. While ownership decides, the account-wide picks are gated by what the account owns. The ruling is **R1833000**.

### What changed

- **Registry** (`crates/server/cosmetics.json`): the issue's 36 entries are appended after #1827's portraits, so no existing entry moves and old opening logs still replay (R1301003).
  - The new entries are six foils, six finishes, six borders, six playmats, six backdrops and six card backs.
  - None of them is a default or a starter.
  - `chase: true` is set exactly on the Legendary and Mythic entries. The issue's table has 15 of those; its acceptance text says "12", which is a miscount, so I followed the table.
  - The playmats, backdrops and card backs are all Epic or better (R1661000).
  - `apps/web/src/wire/generated/cosmetics.ts` is regenerated.
- **Server**
  - `owns_account_cosmetic` is new, and `owns_portrait` now uses it.
  - `put_deck` refuses a `tableCosmetic`, `fieldCosmetic` or `cardBackCosmetic` the account does not own: 400, and nothing is written. This matches the portrait check R1827000 added.
  - The rolls, the global pool (now five portraits plus 18 account cosmetics), cosmetic packs, the Chase Shard purchase and tokens all work on the larger registry without special cases.
  - Nothing grants the 36 to any account, existing ones included (§14.12).
- **Web: ownership** (CLAUDE.md rule 7: the client only reads `GET /api/cosmetics`)
  - `AccountCosmeticsOwned` and `ViewerAccountCosmetics` share the cached ownership read with full art.
  - While ownership decides, the Collection's tiles and the deck builder's selects offer only defaults, starters and owned cosmetics. The account-wide foil, finish and border selects offer only defaults and starters, because a per-card cosmetic is owned on one card.
  - A stored pick the account does not own draws as its kind's default.
  - Practice, hotseat and R1310004's builds still count every cosmetic as owned.
- **Web: looks**
  - The 36 looks are CSS only, in `cosmetics.css`, `table.css` and `collection.css`. Chases are animated, only inside the motion gate and by transform or opacity, and each has a still frame under reduced motion.
  - Legendary and Mythic finishes and borders take one of the foil's limited motion slots (`MOVING_FINISHES_AND_BORDERS`).
  - A new `CosmeticLook` shows each cosmetic's look in both pack reveals, the token redeem rows and the Chase Shard rows.
- **Spec**
  - R1833000 is new.
  - §14.2, §14.3, §14.6, §9.4 and §10.10 are edited.
  - R1297000, R1301002, R1305003, R1306001, R1306002, R1310002, R1333000, R1339000, R1661000, R1661001 and R1827000 are amended.
  - `spec/11-rulings.md` has a new paragraph for R1833000, and `INDEX.md` is regenerated.

### Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Deck save refusal:** the server also refuses an unowned deck pick, for the same treatment as R1827000's portraits. The rejected alternative was a check in the client only, which any client could get around. A person may drop the server check.
- **Account-wide foil, finish and border:** these defaults offer only defaults and starters. The rejected alternative was offering every owned per-card cosmetic, which would not make sense as a default for every card.
- **Unowned entries:** they are left out of the selects rather than shown as locked options, because a select cannot show a locked entry the way a tile does.
- **Chase playmats:** these animate their unit pads, because a playmat has no free layer to animate by transform or opacity.

### Open questions for a person

- **Token bars:** 18 new per-card drops mean far fewer duplicates are spent, so token bars probably fill more slowly than `CARD_TOKEN_BAR_TARGET_PACKS` and `COSMETIC_TOKEN_BAR_TARGET_PACKS` assume. I changed no economy number.
- **Chinese names:** the 36 new names have no Chinese translations yet; they fall back to English.

### Testing

- **Earlier passes:**
  - **Rust:** `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace` passed. `cargo test --workspace` passed (13,972 tests) and left `apps/web/src/wire` clean. `spec check`, `catalog check` and `patches check` passed.
  - **Web:** `typecheck` and eslint passed. The harness's `vitest --changed` run passed 3,566 tests, plus 2 Almanac tests that timed out only while a cargo build ran in parallel. Alone they run as fast as on main.
  - **Cypress:** `card-cosmetics` (37) and `deck-cosmetics` (36) passed.
- **This pass:** only spec text changed. `cargo jackioh spec index` and `cargo jackioh spec check` passed: 1135 rulings, 2632 proofs, 37016 citations, 12232 links, ok.
- **Screenshots still needed:** I took the twelve chase screenshots (`ui-walkthrough`, desktop and phone width), but the bot cannot upload images. **A person must attach them to this PR.**

### Review findings (pass 2), all of which held

1. **`spec/10-engine-guide.md:236`, §10.10 said the deck's playmat, backdrop and card back are "every one unlocked".** It held. I removed the phrase and added that, while ownership decides, the tiles and deck selects offer only defaults, starters and owned cosmetics. An unowned stored pick draws as the default, and practice, hotseat and the development and end-to-end builds count every cosmetic as owned (R1833000).
2. **`spec/10-engine-guide.md:234`, §10.10 said the foil, finish and border are "every one unlocked".** It held. I removed the phrase and added that a card wears one only where the account owns it on that card, with defaults and starters everywhere. The account-wide selects offer only defaults and starters while ownership decides (R1655000, R1833000).
3. **`spec/09-architecture.md:54`, §9.4 did not mention the server's ownership check on deck picks.** It held. The sentence now adds "and on the server one the account owns ([[R1833000]])", matching what it already says for the portrait.
4. **`spec/rulings/R1297000.md`, R1297000 was not amended.** It held. Its title says "amended by R1833000". "Which pick wins" now says the deck editor offers only the default, starters and owned cosmetics while ownership decides. "Saving them" now says the server also refuses an unowned pick. I added R1297000 to R1833000's amends (title, closing paragraph and §11 paragraph), and §9.4 and §10.10 to its `cards`.
5. **`spec/11-rulings.md:514`, the R1661000/R1661001 paragraph still said the shipped account cosmetics are all starters.** It held. It now says they were all starters at the time, and that #1827's portraits and #1833's playmats, backdrops and card backs added the first that are not.
